hedging_delta.evidence: Both calls use similar hedged forward language ('we expect', 'we anticipate') at comparable density.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q1'25 decline 'well above normal seasonality' with no figure; current specifies Q1'25 revenue $2.51B, down 27.6% YoY/24.4% sequentially, and CapEx cut to $2.0-2.3B from $2.5B, and $20B ambition postponed to 2030.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Cost savings target now quantified at $300M-$360M exiting 2027 vs prior vague 'high triple-digit million-dollar range', a downward revision; also $20B+ revenue plan pushed from unspecified date to 2030.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New Silicon Carbide Campus in Catania, Geely supply agreement, STM32N6 NPU, Total PPA, and CMD 2027/28 financial model are newly detailed.

tone_delta.evidence: Current call emphasizes '2024 turned out to be one of the worst years in many decades' vs prior's more neutral framing of 'opportunities and challenges'.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior cited 'continuing delayed recovery' and 'further deterioration'; current confirms 'delayed recovery', 'slowdown', and book-to-bill 'still below parity', with a much steeper Q1 sequential decline guided.
